annotation.evidence_span: Implementations MAY reduce the congestion window immediately upon entering a recovery period or use other mechanisms
annotation.interpretation_a: Implementations can choose to reduce the congestion window immediately upon entering recovery.
annotation.interpretation_b: Implementations can choose to *not* reduce the congestion window immediately, and instead rely on other mechanisms like PRR to reduce it more gradually.
annotation.justification: The clause states that implementations *may* do either of two things, but does not specify *when* or *if* they must choose one or the other. It is unclear if an implementation is allowed to do neither, or if it must do at least one. This creates a missing constraint on the implementation.
